title: Foundations
summary: Every great story is built from small choices. Learn to make every word count, show feelings instead of naming them, paint pictures with your senses, and pick words that spark.
bigIdeas: Short can be powerful: every word has a job.
Showing lets readers feel the story for themselves.
Sensory details help readers step inside a scene.
Strong, precise words make writing come alive.

projectSpec.title: My First Story
projectSpec.description: Write a short story (500–750 words) that uses a six-word-story-style title, at least three showing moments, sensory details, and strong verbs.
